name: IIFL Capital
why: Latest quarter Sep 2026: Excellent (sales +25% YoY, profit +49% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 63% to 59% of sales)
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Not at record: quarterly profit, annual profit
Working capital stretching - debtor days 7 to 9, inventory days n/a (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 5.0 pts in a year
Promoter holding fell 5.1 pts in a year
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only -18% of 3-year profit

capex: Fees and commissions were virtually flat, down 4% to INR134 crores versus INR139 crores.
Fees and commissions increased 8%, INR273 crores versus INR253 crores, admin expense was up 6%.
risks: The global environment remained challenging during Q2 FY27 because of geopolitical tensions, elevated oil prices, high interest rates, and that has led to increased volatility across multiple asset classes.
In this environment, because of inflation pressure, crude price pressure, currency pressure and outgoing foreign flows, we have to closely monitor the happenings on the macroeconomic front.
focus: We remain focused on disciplined growth, prudent capital allocation, governance and risk management.
Or are we have the same focus on insurance business?
And for the next 2 quarters, we'll focus on this because before the new regulat ions kick in.
